binge-watch = to watch many episodes of a series one after another
potter about = to do small, pleasant jobs at home in a relaxed way
while away = to spend time in a pleasant, unhurried way
DIY = repairing or decorating your home yourself instead of paying a professional
fulfilment = a feeling that your life or hobbies are meaningful and satisfying
homebody = a person who prefers staying at home to going out
party animal = a person who loves going to parties and staying out late
life and soul of the party = the person who makes a social event lively and fun
wallflower = someone who stays at the edge of a party and does not join in
social butterfly = a person who moves easily from group to group and loves socialising
recluse = a person who lives a very private life and avoids other people
fit in = to be accepted because you seem similar to the others
left out = not included in a group or activity
small talk = polite, light conversation about unimportant topics
get-together = an informal meeting of friends or relatives
switch off = to stop thinking about work or worries; to turn a device off
screen time = the amount of time spent looking at phones, tablets or televisions
digital detox = a period when you avoid phones and other devices on purpose
stand up to = to refuse to accept unfair treatment or pressure
unwind after work = to relax once the working day is over
